prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / style-transfer.
Asset type: high-fidelity Simplified Chinese desktop application visual proposal 04 for PeerGlide / 屏跃.
Input image 1 is a reference for the device-first composition and brand symbol ONLY. User now explicitly asks for ANIME-INSPIRED COLORS; blue-white, forest-green/lime, and monochrome graphite proposals were rejected.
Art direction: “樱花汽水” — pastel anime-inspired lavender + sakura pink, with tiny icy-blue highlights. A grown-up playful Japanese-anime-adjacent desktop utility, coherent product design, not generic business blue and not gray. Saturated accents against soft airy surfaces, lively but clean.
Precise palette: background very pale lavender #F0ECFA; side navigation deep dusky violet #392849 with light lavender lettering; cards pale sakura ivory #FFFAFF; main text #332444; secondary text readable muted plum #70577E; primary button rich raspberry pink #BA3D83 with white lettering; selected-nav indicator sakura #F2A1CE; small detail icy blue #99DDF0. Purple/pink dominate; NO green/lime theme. Ice blue limited to small decorative illustration details, never the main theme.
Round-but-refined 12–16px corner radii, very subtle lilac shadows, fine lavender borders, clean Chinese typography, generous 8px-based spacing. A few tiny original four-point sparkle motifs near the brand only. No excessive glow, neon cyberpunk, giant gradients or unreadable decorative lettering. No characters, mascots, copyrighted anime art, hearts everywhere, childish stickers, badges or game HUD. Keep it recognizably useful daily desktop software.
Brand mark: small violet rounded square with the original white linked-double-screen glyph, one pale pink glide bridge; preserve the original simple double-screen shape. Sidebar and page chrome belong to the same lavender/pink system. Device illustrations: clean original grayscale hardware with cel-shaded anime pastel sky wallpapers (lavender clouds, pink horizon, tiny icy highlights), no actual anime characters.
Flat straight-on full desktop app window in landscape approximately16:10. Left navigation~190px, main two device cards, one primary action area, compact screen-position preview, unavailable-feature entries below. No permanent third inspector.
Exact visible Chinese:
Brand 屏跃, small PeerGlide.
Sidebar 总览; 设备与屏幕 selected; 本机鼠标 with 预览; 剪贴板与文件 with 开发中; 设置 at bottom.
Heading 设备与屏幕, subtitle 一套键鼠，自在穿梭。
Header right 停止协同 disabled, 恢复本机, ＋ 添加电脑 as QUIET outlined/ghost secondary controls. No solid pink header button.
Tabs 设备 selected, 屏幕布局.
Local card 这台 Mac / 本机 / 键鼠权限待检查 / 输入：未开启.
Peer card Windows 工作电脑 / 已连接 · 仅通信 / 键鼠尚未开启 / 接收许可由对方设置 / overflow dots.
Action region: 已连接，键鼠尚未开启 / 先检查本机权限，再由双方分别确认。 ONE solid raspberry CTA 检查本机键鼠权限. Quiet secondary 断开连接.
Section 屏幕位置, quiet link 调整布局 →. Two small lilac-outlined main-screen blocks 本机 and 工作电脑 with a subtle lavender connecting line; caption 相对位置示意.
Bottom entries 本机鼠标 · 窗口内预览 and 剪贴板与文件 · 尚未接通 with consistent original line icons.
Outside app frame small caption 屏跃 · 视觉提案 04 · 樱花汽水 and 设备与状态为设计示例.
No green ready tick, no real-control claim, no account, VIP, remote screen streaming, terminal, invented latency, extra devices or unsupported feature enabled. All Chinese must be crisp and correct. This is a design proposal, not a running screenshot.
